integrity: The hyperbolic-geometry proof covers all positive radii and all indicated integer vertex counts; finite numerical checks corroborate rather than replace it. Historical originality remains a best-knowledge assessment.
scientific_limitations: Curvature -1, convex regular finite-radius geodesic polygons, n>=3 only; arbitrary polygons and variable curvature not covered. The known ideal-polygon endpoint is background.
title: Exact slimness and a contact transition for compact regular hyperbolic polygons
